verses.ar: سُبۡحٰنَ الَّذِيۡ٘ اَسۡرٰي بِعَبۡدِهٖ لَيۡلًا مِّنَ الۡمَسۡجِدِ الۡحَرَامِ اِلَي الۡمَسۡجِدِ الۡاَقۡصَا الَّذِيۡ بٰرَكۡنَا حَوۡلَهٗ لِنُرِيَهٗ مِنۡ اٰيٰتِنَاؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ السَّمِيۡعُ الۡبَصِيۡرُ
verses.en: Glory to (Allah) Who did take His servant for a Journey by night from the Sacred Mosque to the farthest Mosque, whose precincts We did bless,- in order that We might show him some of Our Signs: for He is the One Who heareth and seeth (all things)

verses.ar: وَاٰتَيۡنَا مُوۡسَي الۡكِتٰبَ وَجَعَلۡنٰهُ هُدًي لِّبَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَ اَلَّا تَتَّخِذُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِيۡ وَكِيۡلًاؕ‏
verses.en: We gave Moses the Book, and made it a Guide to the Children of Israel, (commanding): "Take not other than Me as Disposer of (your) affairs

verses.ar: ذُرِّيَّةَ مَنۡ حَمَلۡنَا مَعَ نُوۡحٍؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ عَبۡدًا شَكُوۡرًا
verses.en: O ye that are sprung from those whom We carried (in the Ark) with Noah! Verily he was a devotee most grateful

verses.ar: وَقَضَيۡنَا٘ اِلٰي بَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَ فِي الۡكِتٰبِ لَتُفۡسِدُنَّ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ مَرَّتَيۡنِ وَلَتَعۡلُنَّ عُلُوًّا كَبِيۡرًا
verses.en: And We gave (Clear) Warning to the Children of Israel in the Book, that twice would they do mischief on the earth and be elated with mighty arrogance (and twice would they be punished)

verses.ar: فَاِذَا جَآءَ وَعۡدُ اُوۡلٰىهُمَا بَعَثۡنَا عَلَيۡكُمۡ عِبَادًا لَّنَا٘ اُولِيۡ بَاۡسٍ شَدِيۡدٍ فَجَاسُوۡا خِلٰلَ الدِّيَارِؕ وَكَانَ وَعۡدًا مَّفۡعُوۡلًا
verses.en: When the first of the warnings came to pass, We sent against you Our servants given to terrible warfare: They entered the very inmost parts of your homes; and it was a warning (completely) fulfilled

verses.ar: ثُمَّ رَدَدۡنَا لَكُمُ الۡكَرَّةَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَاَمۡدَدۡنٰكُمۡ بِاَمۡوَالٍ وَّبَنِيۡنَ وَجَعَلۡنٰكُمۡ اَكۡثَرَ نَفِيۡرًا
verses.en: Then did We grant you the Return as against them: We gave you increase in resources and sons, and made you the more numerous in man-power

verses.ar: اِنۡ اَحۡسَنۡتُمۡ اَحۡسَنۡتُمۡ لِاَنۡفُسِكُمۡࣞ وَاِنۡ اَسَاۡتُمۡ فَلَهَاؕ فَاِذَا جَآءَ وَعۡدُ الۡاٰخِرَةِ لِيَسُوۡٓءٗا وُجُوۡهَكُمۡ وَلِيَدۡخُلُوا الۡمَسۡجِدَ كَمَا دَخَلُوۡهُ اَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَّلِيُتَبِّرُوۡا مَا عَلَوۡا تَتۡبِيۡرًا
verses.en: If ye did well, ye did well for yourselves; if ye did evil, (ye did it) against yourselves. So when the second of the warnings came to pass, (We permitted your enemies) to disfigure your faces, and to enter your Temple as they had entered it before, and to visit with destruction all that fell into their power

verses.ar: عَسٰي رَبُّكُمۡ اَنۡ يَّرۡحَمَكُمۡۚ وَاِنۡ عُدۡتُّمۡ عُدۡنَاۘ وَجَعَلۡنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ حَصِيۡرًا
verses.en: It may be that your Lord may (yet) show Mercy unto you; but if ye revert (to your sins), We shall revert (to Our punishments): And we have made Hell a prison for those who reject (all Faith)

verses.ar: اِنَّ هٰذَا الۡقُرۡاٰنَ يَهۡدِيۡ لِلَّتِيۡ هِيَ اَقۡوَمُ وَيُبَشِّرُ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ الَّذِيۡنَ يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ الصّٰلِحٰتِ اَنَّ لَهُمۡ اَجۡرًا كَبِيۡرًاۙ‏
verses.en: Verily this Qur'an doth guide to that which is most right (or stable), and giveth the Glad Tidings to the Believers who work deeds of righteousness, that they shall have a magnificent reward

verses.ar: وَّاَنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِالۡاٰخِرَةِ اَعۡتَدۡنَا لَهُمۡ عَذَابًا اَلِيۡمًاࣖ‏
verses.en: And to those who believe not in the Hereafter, (it announceth) that We have prepared for them a Penalty Grievous (indeed)

verses.ar: وَيَدۡعُ الۡاِنۡسَانُ بِالشَّرِّ دُعَآءَهٗ بِالۡخَيۡرِؕ وَكَانَ الۡاِنۡسَانُ عَجُوۡلًا
verses.en: The prayer that man should make for good, he maketh for evil; for man is given to hasty (deeds)

verses.ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا الَّيۡلَ وَالنَّهَارَ اٰيَتَيۡنِ فَمَحَوۡنَا٘ اٰيَةَ الَّيۡلِ وَجَعَلۡنَا٘ اٰيَةَ النَّهَارِ مُبۡصِرَةً لِّتَبۡتَغُوۡا فَضۡلًا مِّنۡ رَّبِّكُمۡ وَلِتَعۡلَمُوۡا عَدَدَ السِّنِيۡنَ وَالۡحِسَابَؕ وَكُلَّ شَيۡءٍ فَصَّلۡنٰهُ تَفۡصِيۡلًا
verses.en: We have made the Night and the Day as two (of Our) Signs: the Sign of the Night have We obscured, while the Sign of the Day We have made to enlighten you; that ye may seek bounty from your Lord, and that ye may know the number and count of the years: all things have We explained in detail

verses.ar: وَكُلَّ اِنۡسَانٍ اَلۡزَمۡنٰهُ طٰٓئِرَهٗ فِيۡ عُنُقِهٖؕ وَنُخۡرِجُ لَهٗ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ كِتٰبًا يَّلۡقٰىهُ مَنۡشُوۡرًا
verses.en: Every man's fate We have fastened on his own neck: On the Day of Judgment We shall bring out for him a scroll, which he will see spread open

verses.ar: اِقۡرَاۡ كِتٰبَكَؕ كَفٰي بِنَفۡسِكَ الۡيَوۡمَ عَلَيۡكَ حَسِيۡبًاؕ‏
verses.en: (It will be said to him:) "Read thine (own) record: Sufficient is thy soul this day to make out an account against thee

verses.ar: مَنِ اهۡتَدٰي فَاِنَّمَا يَهۡتَدِيۡ لِنَفۡسِهٖۚ وَمَنۡ ضَلَّ فَاِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيۡهَاؕ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِّزۡرَ اُخۡرٰيؕ وَمَا كُنَّا مُعَذِّبِيۡنَ حَتّٰي نَبۡعَثَ رَسُوۡلًا
verses.en: Who receiveth guidance, receiveth it for his own benefit: who goeth astray doth so to his own loss: No bearer of burdens can bear the burden of another: nor would We visit with Our Wrath until We had sent an messenger (to give warning)

verses.ar: وَاِذَا٘ اَرَدۡنَا٘ اَنۡ نُّهۡلِكَ قَرۡيَةً اَمَرۡنَا مُتۡرَفِيۡهَا فَفَسَقُوۡا فِيۡهَا فَحَقَّ عَلَيۡهَا الۡقَوۡلُ فَدَمَّرۡنٰهَا تَدۡمِيۡرًا
verses.en: When We decide to destroy a population, We (first) send a definite order to those among them who are given the good things of this life and yet transgress; so that the word is proved true against them: then (it is) We destroy them utterly

verses.ar: وَكَمۡ اَهۡلَكۡنَا مِنَ الۡقُرُوۡنِ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ نُوۡحٍؕ وَكَفٰي بِرَبِّكَ بِذُنُوۡبِ عِبَادِهٖ خَبِيۡرًاۭ بَصِيۡرًا
verses.en: How many generations have We destroyed after Noah? and enough is thy Lord to note and see the sins of His servants

verses.ar: مَنۡ كَانَ يُرِيۡدُ الۡعَاجِلَةَ عَجَّلۡنَا لَهٗ فِيۡهَا مَا نَشَآءُ لِمَنۡ نُّرِيۡدُ ثُمَّ جَعَلۡنَا لَهٗ جَهَنَّمَۚ يَصۡلٰىهَا مَذۡمُوۡمًا مَّدۡحُوۡرًا
verses.en: If any do wish for the transitory things (of this life), We readily grant them - such things as We will, to such person as We will: in the end have We provided Hell for them: they will burn therein, disgraced and rejected

verses.ar: وَمَنۡ اَرَادَ الۡاٰخِرَةَ وَسَعٰي لَهَا سَعۡيَهَا وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنٌ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ كَانَ سَعۡيُهُمۡ مَّشۡكُوۡرًا
verses.en: Those who do wish for the (things of) the Hereafter, and strive therefor with all due striving, and have Faith,- they are the ones whose striving is acceptable (to Allah)

verses.ar: كُلًّا نُّمِدُّ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ وَهٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ مِنۡ عَطَآءِ رَبِّكَؕ وَمَا كَانَ عَطَآءُ رَبِّكَ مَحۡظُوۡرًا
verses.en: Of the bounties of thy Lord We bestow freely on all- These as well as those: The bounties of thy Lord are not closed (to anyone)

verses.ar: اُنۡظُرۡ كَيۡفَ فَضَّلۡنَا بَعۡضَهُمۡ عَلٰي بَعۡضٍؕ وَلَلۡاٰخِرَةُ اَكۡبَرُ دَرَجٰتٍ وَّاَكۡبَرُ تَفۡضِيۡلًا
verses.en: See how We have bestowed more on some than on others; but verily the Hereafter is more in rank and gradation and more in excellence

verses.ar: لَا تَجۡعَلۡ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَ فَتَقۡعُدَ مَذۡمُوۡمًا مَّخۡذُوۡلًاࣖ‏
verses.en: Take not with Allah another object of worship; or thou (O man!) wilt sit in disgrace and destitution

verses.ar: وَقَضٰي رَبُّكَ اَلَّا تَعۡبُدُوۡ٘ا اِلَّا٘ اِيَّاهُ وَبِالۡوَالِدَيۡنِ اِحۡسَانًاؕ اِمَّا يَبۡلُغَنَّ عِنۡدَكَ الۡكِبَرَ اَحَدُهُمَا٘ اَوۡ كِلٰهُمَا فَلَا تَقُلۡ لَّهُمَا٘ اُفٍّ وَّلَا تَنۡهَرۡهُمَا وَقُلۡ لَّهُمَا قَوۡلًا كَرِيۡمًا
verses.en: Thy Lord hath decreed that ye worship none but Him, and that ye be kind to parents. Whether one or both of them attain old age in thy life, say not to them a word of contempt, nor repel them, but address them in terms of honour

verses.ar: وَاخۡفِضۡ لَهُمَا جَنَاحَ الذُّلِّ مِنَ الرَّحۡمَةِ وَقُلۡ رَّبِّ ارۡحَمۡهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيٰنِيۡ صَغِيۡرًاؕ‏
verses.en: And, out of kindness, lower to them the wing of humility, and say: "My Lord! bestow on them thy Mercy even as they cherished me in childhood

verses.ar: رَبُّكُمۡ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَا فِيۡ نُفُوۡسِكُمۡؕ اِنۡ تَكُوۡنُوۡا صٰلِحِيۡنَ فَاِنَّهٗ كَانَ لِلۡاَوَّابِيۡنَ غَفُوۡرًا
verses.en: Your Lord knoweth best what is in your hearts: If ye do deeds of righteousness, verily He is Most Forgiving to those who turn to Him again and again (in true penitence)

verses.ar: وَاٰتِ ذَا الۡقُرۡبٰي حَقَّهٗ وَالۡمِسۡكِيۡنَ وَابۡنَ السَّبِيۡلِ وَلَا تُبَذِّرۡ تَبۡذِيۡرًا
verses.en: And render to the kindred their due rights, as (also) to those in want, and to the wayfarer: But squander not (your wealth) in the manner of a spendthrift

verses.ar: اِنَّ الۡمُبَذِّرِيۡنَ كَانُوۡ٘ا اِخۡوَانَ الشَّيٰطِيۡنِؕ وَكَانَ الشَّيۡطٰنُ لِرَبِّهٖ كَفُوۡرًا
verses.en: Verily spendthrifts are brothers of the Evil Ones; and the Evil One is to his Lord (himself) ungrateful

verses.ar: وَاِمَّا تُعۡرِضَنَّ عَنۡهُمُ ابۡتِغَآءَ رَحۡمَةٍ مِّنۡ رَّبِّكَ تَرۡجُوۡهَا فَقُلۡ لَّهُمۡ قَوۡلًا مَّيۡسُوۡرًا
verses.en: And even if thou hast to turn away from them in pursuit of the Mercy from thy Lord which thou dost expect, yet speak to them a word of easy kindness

verses.ar: وَلَا تَجۡعَلۡ يَدَكَ مَغۡلُوۡلَةً اِلٰي عُنُقِكَ وَلَا تَبۡسُطۡهَا كُلَّ الۡبَسۡطِ فَتَقۡعُدَ مَلُوۡمًا مَّحۡسُوۡرًا
verses.en: Make not thy hand tied (like a niggard's) to thy neck, nor stretch it forth to its utmost reach, so that thou become blameworthy and destitute

verses.ar: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَبۡسُطُ الرِّزۡقَ لِمَنۡ يَّشَآءُ وَيَقۡدِرُؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهٖ خَبِيۡرًاۭ بَصِيۡرًاࣖ‏
verses.en: Verily thy Lord doth provide sustenance in abundance for whom He pleaseth, and He provideth in a just measure. For He doth know and regard all His servants

verses.ar: وَلَا تَقۡتُلُوۡ٘ا اَوۡلَادَكُمۡ خَشۡيَةَ اِمۡلَاقٍؕ نَحۡنُ نَرۡزُقُهُمۡ وَاِيَّاكُمۡؕ اِنَّ قَتۡلَهُمۡ كَانَ خِطۡاً كَبِيۡرًا
verses.en: Kill not your children for fear of want: We shall provide sustenance for them as well as for you. Verily the killing of them is a great sin

verses.ar: وَلَا تَقۡرَبُوا الزِّنٰ٘ي اِنَّهٗ كَانَ فَاحِشَةًؕ وَسَآءَ سَبِيۡلًا
verses.en: Nor come nigh to adultery: for it is a shameful (deed) and an evil, opening the road (to other evils)

verses.ar: وَلَا تَقۡتُلُوا النَّفۡسَ الَّتِيۡ حَرَّمَ اللّٰهُ اِلَّا بِالۡحَقِّؕ وَمَنۡ قُتِلَ مَظۡلُوۡمًا فَقَدۡ جَعَلۡنَا لِوَلِيِّهٖ سُلۡطٰنًا فَلَا يُسۡرِفۡ فِّي الۡقَتۡلِؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ مَنۡصُوۡرًا
verses.en: Nor take life - which Allah has made sacred - except for just cause. And if anyone is slain wrongfully, we have given his heir authority (to demand qisas or to forgive): but let him not exceed bounds in the matter of taking life; for he is helped (by the Law)

verses.ar: وَلَا تَقۡرَبُوۡا مَالَ الۡيَتِيۡمِ اِلَّا بِالَّتِيۡ هِيَ اَحۡسَنُ حَتّٰي يَبۡلُغَ اَشُدَّهٗࣕ وَاَوۡفُوۡا بِالۡعَهۡدِۚ اِنَّ الۡعَهۡدَ كَانَ مَسۡـُٔوۡلًا
verses.en: Come not nigh to the orphan's property except to improve it, until he attains the age of full strength; and fulfil (every) engagement, for (every) engagement will be enquired into (on the Day of Reckoning)

verses.ar: وَاَوۡفُوا الۡكَيۡلَ اِذَا كِلۡتُمۡ وَزِنُوۡا بِالۡقِسۡطَاسِ الۡمُسۡتَقِيۡمِؕ ذٰلِكَ خَيۡرٌ وَّاَحۡسَنُ تَاۡوِيۡلًا
verses.en: Give full measure when ye measure, and weigh with a balance that is straight: that is the most fitting and the most advantageous in the final determination

verses.ar: وَلَا تَقۡفُ مَا لَيۡسَ لَكَ بِهٖ عِلۡمٌؕ اِنَّ السَّمۡعَ وَالۡبَصَرَ وَالۡفُؤَادَ كُلُّ اُولٰٓئِكَ كَانَ عَنۡهُ مَسۡـُٔوۡلًا
verses.en: And pursue not that of which thou hast no knowledge; for every act of hearing, or of seeing or of (feeling in) the heart will be enquired into (on the Day of Reckoning)

verses.ar: وَلَا تَمۡشِ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ مَرَحًاۚ اِنَّكَ لَنۡ تَخۡرِقَ الۡاَرۡضَ وَلَنۡ تَبۡلُغَ الۡجِبَالَ طُوۡلًا
verses.en: Nor walk on the earth with insolence: for thou canst not rend the earth asunder, nor reach the mountains in height

verses.ar: كُلُّ ذٰلِكَ كَانَ سَيِّئُهٗ عِنۡدَ رَبِّكَ مَكۡرُوۡهًا
verses.en: Of all such things the evil is hateful in the sight of thy Lord

verses.ar: ذٰلِكَ مِمَّا٘ اَوۡحٰ٘ي اِلَيۡكَ رَبُّكَ مِنَ الۡحِكۡمَةِؕ وَلَا تَجۡعَلۡ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَ فَتُلۡقٰي فِيۡ جَهَنَّمَ مَلُوۡمًا مَّدۡحُوۡرًا
verses.en: These are among the (precepts of) wisdom, which thy Lord has revealed to thee. Take not, with Allah, another object of worship, lest thou shouldst be thrown into Hell, blameworthy and rejected

verses.ar: اَفَاَصۡفٰىكُمۡ رَبُّكُمۡ بِالۡبَنِيۡنَ وَاتَّخَذَ مِنَ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةِ اِنَاثًاؕ اِنَّكُمۡ لَتَقُوۡلُوۡنَ قَوۡلًا عَظِيۡمًاࣖ‏
verses.en: Has then your Lord (O Pagans!) preferred for you sons, and taken for Himself daughters among the angels? Truly ye utter a most dreadful saying

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ صَرَّفۡنَا فِيۡ هٰذَا الۡقُرۡاٰنِ لِيَذَّكَّرُوۡاؕ وَمَا يَزِيۡدُهُمۡ اِلَّا نُفُوۡرًا
verses.en: We have explained (things) in various (ways) in this Qur'an, in order that they may receive admonition, but it only increases their flight (from the Truth)

verses.ar: قُلۡ لَّوۡ كَانَ مَعَهٗ٘ اٰلِهَةٌ كَمَا يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ اِذًا لَّابۡتَغَوۡا اِلٰي ذِي الۡعَرۡشِ سَبِيۡلًا
verses.en: Say: If there had been (other) gods with Him, as they say,- behold, they would certainly have sought out a way to the Lord of the Throne

verses.ar: سُبۡحٰنَهٗ وَتَعٰلٰي عَمَّا يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ عُلُوًّا كَبِيۡرًا
verses.en: Glory to Him! He is high above all that they say!- Exalted and Great (beyond measure)

verses.ar: تُسَبِّحُ لَهُ السَّمٰوٰتُ السَّبۡعُ وَالۡاَرۡضُ وَمَنۡ فِيۡهِنَّؕ وَاِنۡ مِّنۡ شَيۡءٍ اِلَّا يُسَبِّحُ بِحَمۡدِهٖ وَلٰكِنۡ لَّا تَفۡقَهُوۡنَ تَسۡبِيۡحَهُمۡؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ حَلِيۡمًا غَفُوۡرًا
verses.en: The seven heavens and the earth, and all beings therein, declare His glory: there is not a thing but celebrates His praise; And yet ye understand not how they declare His glory! Verily He is Oft-Forbear, Most Forgiving

verses.ar: وَاِذَا قَرَاۡتَ الۡقُرۡاٰنَ جَعَلۡنَا بَيۡنَكَ وَبَيۡنَ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِالۡاٰخِرَةِ حِجَابًا مَّسۡتُوۡرًاۙ‏
verses.en: When thou dost recite the Qur'an, We put, between thee and those who believe not in the Hereafter, a veil invisible

verses.ar: وَّجَعَلۡنَا عَلٰي قُلُوۡبِهِمۡ اَكِنَّةً اَنۡ يَّفۡقَهُوۡهُ وَفِيۡ٘ اٰذَانِهِمۡ وَقۡرًاؕ وَاِذَا ذَكَرۡتَ رَبَّكَ فِي الۡقُرۡاٰنِ وَحۡدَهٗ وَلَّوۡا عَلٰ٘ي اَدۡبَارِهِمۡ نُفُوۡرًا
verses.en: And We put coverings over their hearts (and minds) lest they should understand the Qur'an, and deafness into their ears: when thou dost commemorate thy Lord and Him alone in the Qur'an, they turn on their backs, fleeing (from the Truth)

verses.ar: نَحۡنُ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَسۡتَمِعُوۡنَ بِهٖ٘ اِذۡ يَسۡتَمِعُوۡنَ اِلَيۡكَ وَاِذۡ هُمۡ نَجۡوٰ٘ي اِذۡ يَقُوۡلُ الظّٰلِمُوۡنَ اِنۡ تَتَّبِعُوۡنَ اِلَّا رَجُلًا مَّسۡحُوۡرًا
verses.en: We know best why it is they listen, when they listen to thee; and when they meet in private conference, behold, the wicked say, "Ye follow none other than a man bewitched

verses.ar: اُنۡظُرۡ كَيۡفَ ضَرَبُوۡا لَكَ الۡاَمۡثَالَ فَضَلُّوۡا فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَ سَبِيۡلًا
verses.en: See what similes they strike for thee: but they have gone astray, and never can they find a way

verses.ar: وَقَالُوۡ٘ا ءَاِذَا كُنَّا عِظَامًا وَّرُفَاتًا ءَاِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوۡثُوۡنَ خَلۡقًا جَدِيۡدًا
verses.en: They say: "What! when we are reduced to bones and dust, should we really be raised up (to be) a new creation

verses.ar: قُلۡ كُوۡنُوۡا حِجَارَةً اَوۡ حَدِيۡدًاۙ‏
verses.en: Say: "(Nay!) be ye stones or iron

verses.ar: اَوۡ خَلۡقًا مِّمَّا يَكۡبُرُ فِيۡ صُدُوۡرِكُمۡۚ فَسَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ مَنۡ يُّعِيۡدُنَاؕ قُلِ الَّذِيۡ فَطَرَكُمۡ اَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍۚ فَسَيُنۡغِضُوۡنَ اِلَيۡكَ رُءُوۡسَهُمۡ وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ مَتٰي هُوَؕ قُلۡ عَسٰ٘ي اَنۡ يَّكُوۡنَ قَرِيۡبًا
verses.en: Or created matter which, in your minds, is hardest (to be raised up),- (Yet shall ye be raised up)!" then will they say: "Who will cause us to return?" Say: "He who created you first!" Then will they wag their heads towards thee, and say, "When will that be?" Say, "May be it will be quite soon

verses.ar: يَوۡمَ يَدۡعُوۡكُمۡ فَتَسۡتَجِيۡبُوۡنَ بِحَمۡدِهٖ وَتَظُنُّوۡنَ اِنۡ لَّبِثۡتُمۡ اِلَّا قَلِيۡلًاࣖ‏
verses.en: It will be on a Day when He will call you, and ye will answer (His call) with (words of) His praise, and ye will think that ye tarried but a little while

verses.ar: وَقُلۡ لِّعِبَادِيۡ يَقُوۡلُوا الَّتِيۡ هِيَ اَحۡسَنُؕ اِنَّ الشَّيۡطٰنَ يَنۡزَغُ بَيۡنَهُمۡؕ اِنَّ الشَّيۡطٰنَ كَانَ لِلۡاِنۡسَانِ عَدُوًّا مُّبِيۡنًا
verses.en: Say to My servants that they should (only) say those things that are best: for Satan doth sow dissensions among them: For Satan is to man an avowed enemy

verses.ar: رَبُّكُمۡ اَعۡلَمُ بِكُمۡؕ اِنۡ يَّشَاۡ يَرۡحَمۡكُمۡ اَوۡ اِنۡ يَّشَاۡ يُعَذِّبۡكُمۡؕ وَمَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنٰكَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَكِيۡلًا
verses.en: It is your Lord that knoweth you best: If He please, He granteth you mercy, or if He please, punishment: We have not sent thee to be a disposer of their affairs for them

verses.ar: وَرَبُّكَ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَنۡ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ وَلَقَدۡ فَضَّلۡنَا بَعۡضَ النَّبِيّٖنَ عَلٰي بَعۡضٍ وَّاٰتَيۡنَا دَاوٗدَ زَبُوۡرًا
verses.en: And it is your Lord that knoweth best all beings that are in the heavens and on earth: We did bestow on some prophets more (and other) gifts than on others: and We gave to David (the gift of) the Psalms

verses.ar: قُلِ ادۡعُوا الَّذِيۡنَ زَعَمۡتُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ فَلَا يَمۡلِكُوۡنَ كَشۡفَ الضُّرِّ عَنۡكُمۡ وَلَا تَحۡوِيۡلًا
verses.en: Say: "Call on those - besides Him - whom ye fancy: they have neither the power to remove your troubles from you nor to change them

verses.ar: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيۡنَ يَدۡعُوۡنَ يَبۡتَغُوۡنَ اِلٰي رَبِّهِمُ الۡوَسِيۡلَةَ اَيُّهُمۡ اَقۡرَبُ وَيَرۡجُوۡنَ رَحۡمَتَهٗ وَيَخَافُوۡنَ عَذَابَهٗؕ اِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ كَانَ مَحۡذُوۡرًا
verses.en: Those whom they call upon do desire (for themselves) means of access to their Lord, - even those who are nearest: they hope for His Mercy and fear His Wrath: for the Wrath of thy Lord is something to take heed of

verses.ar: وَاِنۡ مِّنۡ قَرۡيَةٍ اِلَّا نَحۡنُ مُهۡلِكُوۡهَا قَبۡلَ يَوۡمِ الۡقِيٰمَةِ اَوۡ مُعَذِّبُوۡهَا عَذَابًا شَدِيۡدًاؕ كَانَ ذٰلِكَ فِي الۡكِتٰبِ مَسۡطُوۡرًا
verses.en: There is not a population but We shall destroy it before the Day of Judgment or punish it with a dreadful Penalty: that is written in the (eternal) Record

verses.ar: وَمَا مَنَعَنَا٘ اَنۡ نُّرۡسِلَ بِالۡاٰيٰتِ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ كَذَّبَ بِهَا الۡاَوَّلُوۡنَؕ وَاٰتَيۡنَا ثَمُوۡدَ النَّاقَةَ مُبۡصِرَةً فَظَلَمُوۡا بِهَاؕ وَمَا نُرۡسِلُ بِالۡاٰيٰتِ اِلَّا تَخۡوِيۡفًا
verses.en: And We refrain from sending the signs, only because the men of former generations treated them as false: We sent the she-camel to the Thamud to open their eyes, but they treated her wrongfully: We only send the Signs by way of terror (and warning from evil)

verses.ar: وَاِذۡ قُلۡنَا لَكَ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ اَحَاطَ بِالنَّاسِؕ وَمَا جَعَلۡنَا الرُّءۡيَا الَّتِيۡ٘ اَرَيۡنٰكَ اِلَّا فِتۡنَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَالشَّجَرَةَ الۡمَلۡعُوۡنَةَ فِي الۡقُرۡاٰنِؕ وَنُخَوِّفُهُمۡۙ فَمَا يَزِيۡدُهُمۡ اِلَّا طُغۡيَانًا كَبِيۡرًاࣖ‏
verses.en: Behold! We told thee that thy Lord doth encompass mankind round about: We granted the vision which We showed thee, but as a trial for men,- as also the Cursed Tree (mentioned) in the Qur'an: We put terror (and warning) into them, but it only increases their inordinate transgression

verses.ar: وَاِذۡ قُلۡنَا لِلۡمَلٰٓئِكَةِ اسۡجُدُوۡا لِاٰدَمَ فَسَجَدُوۡ٘ا اِلَّا٘ اِبۡلِيۡسَؕ قَالَ ءَاَسۡجُدُ لِمَنۡ خَلَقۡتَ طِيۡنًاۚ‏
verses.en: Behold! We said to the angels: "Bow down unto Adam": They bowed down except Iblis: He said, "Shall I bow down to one whom Thou didst create from clay

verses.ar: قَالَ اَرَءَيۡتَكَ هٰذَا الَّذِيۡ كَرَّمۡتَ عَلَيَّؗ لَئِنۡ اَخَّرۡتَنِ اِلٰي يَوۡمِ الۡقِيٰمَةِ لَاَحۡتَنِكَنَّ ذُرِّيَّتَهٗ٘ اِلَّا قَلِيۡلًا
verses.en: He said: "Seest Thou? this is the one whom Thou hast honoured above me! If Thou wilt but respite me to the Day of Judgment, I will surely bring his descendants under my sway - all but a few

verses.ar: قَالَ اذۡهَبۡ فَمَنۡ تَبِعَكَ مِنۡهُمۡ فَاِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ جَزَآؤُكُمۡ جَزَآءً مَّوۡفُوۡرًا
verses.en: (Allah) said: "Go thy way; if any of them follow thee, verily Hell will be the recompense of you (all)- an ample recompense

verses.ar: وَاسۡتَفۡزِزۡ مَنِ اسۡتَطَعۡتَ مِنۡهُمۡ بِصَوۡتِكَ وَاَجۡلِبۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ بِخَيۡلِكَ وَرَجِلِكَ وَشَارِكۡهُمۡ فِي الۡاَمۡوَالِ وَالۡاَوۡلَادِ وَعِدۡهُمۡؕ وَمَا يَعِدُهُمُ الشَّيۡطٰنُ اِلَّا غُرُوۡرًا
verses.en: Lead to destruction those whom thou canst among them, with thy (seductive) voice; make assaults on them with thy cavalry and thy infantry; mutually share with them wealth and children; and make promises to them." But Satan promises them nothing but deceit

verses.ar: اِنَّ عِبَادِيۡ لَيۡسَ لَكَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ سُلۡطٰنٌؕ وَكَفٰي بِرَبِّكَ وَكِيۡلًا
verses.en: As for My servants, no authority shalt thou have over them:" Enough is thy Lord for a Disposer of affairs

verses.ar: رَبُّكُمُ الَّذِيۡ يُزۡجِيۡ لَكُمُ الۡفُلۡكَ فِي الۡبَحۡرِ لِتَبۡتَغُوۡا مِنۡ فَضۡلِهٖؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ بِكُمۡ رَحِيۡمًا
verses.en: Your Lord is He That maketh the Ship go smoothly for you through the sea, in order that ye may seek of his Bounty. For he is unto you most Merciful

verses.ar: وَاِذَا مَسَّكُمُ الضُّرُّ فِي الۡبَحۡرِ ضَلَّ مَنۡ تَدۡعُوۡنَ اِلَّا٘ اِيَّاهُۚ فَلَمَّا نَجّٰىكُمۡ اِلَي الۡبَرِّ اَعۡرَضۡتُمۡؕ وَكَانَ الۡاِنۡسَانُ كَفُوۡرًا
verses.en: When distress seizes you at sea, those that ye call upon - besides Himself - leave you in the lurch! but when He brings you back safe to land, ye turn away (from Him). Most ungrateful is man

verses.ar: اَفَاَمِنۡتُمۡ اَنۡ يَّخۡسِفَ بِكُمۡ جَانِبَ الۡبَرِّ اَوۡ يُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ حَاصِبًا ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُوۡا لَكُمۡ وَكِيۡلًاۙ‏
verses.en: Do ye then feel secure that He will not cause you to be swallowed up beneath the earth when ye are on land, or that He will not send against you a violent tornado (with showers of stones) so that ye shall find no one to carry out your affairs for you

verses.ar: اَمۡ اَمِنۡتُمۡ اَنۡ يُّعِيۡدَكُمۡ فِيۡهِ تَارَةً اُخۡرٰي فَيُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ قَاصِفًا مِّنَ الرِّيۡحِ فَيُغۡرِقَكُمۡ بِمَا كَفَرۡتُمۡۙ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُوۡا لَكُمۡ عَلَيۡنَا بِهٖ تَبِيۡعًا
verses.en: Or do ye feel secure that He will not send you back a second time to sea and send against you a heavy gale to drown you because of your ingratitude, so that ye find no helper. Therein against Us

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ كَرَّمۡنَا بَنِيۡ٘ اٰدَمَ وَحَمَلۡنٰهُمۡ فِي الۡبَرِّ وَالۡبَحۡرِ وَرَزَقۡنٰهُمۡ مِّنَ الطَّيِّبٰتِ وَفَضَّلۡنٰهُمۡ عَلٰي كَثِيۡرٍ مِّمَّنۡ خَلَقۡنَا تَفۡضِيۡلًاࣖ‏
verses.en: We have honoured the sons of Adam; provided them with transport on land and sea; given them for sustenance things good and pure; and conferred on them special favours, above a great part of our creation

verses.ar: يَوۡمَ نَدۡعُوۡا كُلَّ اُنَاسٍۭ بِاِمَامِهِمۡۚ فَمَنۡ اُوۡتِيَ كِتٰبَهٗ بِيَمِيۡنِهٖ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ يَقۡرَءُوۡنَ كِتٰبَهُمۡ وَلَا يُظۡلَمُوۡنَ فَتِيۡلًا
verses.en: One day We shall call together all human beings with their (respective) Imams: those who are given their record in their right hand will read it (with pleasure), and they will not be dealt with unjustly in the least

verses.ar: وَمَنۡ كَانَ فِيۡ هٰذِهٖ٘ اَعۡمٰي فَهُوَ فِي الۡاٰخِرَةِ اَعۡمٰي وَاَضَلُّ سَبِيۡلًا
verses.en: But those who were blind in this world, will be blind in the hereafter, and most astray from the Path

verses.ar: وَاِنۡ كَادُوۡا لَيَفۡتِنُوۡنَكَ عَنِ الَّذِيۡ٘ اَوۡحَيۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡكَ لِتَفۡتَرِيَ عَلَيۡنَا غَيۡرَهٗࣗۖ وَاِذًا لَّاتَّخَذُوۡكَ خَلِيۡلًا
verses.en: And their purpose was to tempt thee away from that which We had revealed unto thee, to substitute in our name something quite different; (in that case), behold! they would certainly have made thee (their) friend

verses.ar: وَلَوۡلَا٘ اَنۡ ثَبَّتۡنٰكَ لَقَدۡ كِدۡتَّ تَرۡكَنُ اِلَيۡهِمۡ شَيۡـًٔا قَلِيۡلًاۙࣗ‏
verses.en: And had We not given thee strength, thou wouldst nearly have inclined to them a little

verses.ar: اِذًا لَّاَذَقۡنٰكَ ضِعۡفَ الۡحَيٰوةِ وَضِعۡفَ الۡمَمَاتِ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُ لَكَ عَلَيۡنَا نَصِيۡرًا
verses.en: In that case We should have made thee taste an equal portion (of punishment) in this life, and an equal portion in death: and moreover thou wouldst have found none to help thee against Us

verses.ar: وَاِنۡ كَادُوۡا لَيَسۡتَفِزُّوۡنَكَ مِنَ الۡاَرۡضِ لِيُخۡرِجُوۡكَ مِنۡهَا وَاِذًا لَّا يَلۡبَثُوۡنَ خِلٰفَكَ اِلَّا قَلِيۡلًا
verses.en: Their purpose was to scare thee off the land, in order to expel thee; but in that case they would not have stayed (therein) after thee, except for a little while

verses.ar: سُنَّةَ مَنۡ قَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا قَبۡلَكَ مِنۡ رُّسُلِنَا وَلَا تَجِدُ لِسُنَّتِنَا تَحۡوِيۡلًاࣖ‏
verses.en: (This was Our) way with the messengers We sent before thee: thou wilt find no change in Our ways

verses.ar: اَقِمِ الصَّلٰوةَ لِدُلُوۡكِ الشَّمۡسِ اِلٰي غَسَقِ الَّيۡلِ وَقُرۡاٰنَ الۡفَجۡرِؕ اِنَّ قُرۡاٰنَ الۡفَجۡرِ كَانَ مَشۡهُوۡدًا
verses.en: Establish regular prayers - at the sun's decline till the darkness of the night, and the morning prayer and reading: for the prayer and reading in the morning carry their testimony

verses.ar: وَمِنَ الَّيۡلِ فَتَهَجَّدۡ بِهٖ نَافِلَةً لَّكَࣗۖ عَسٰ٘ي اَنۡ يَّبۡعَثَكَ رَبُّكَ مَقَامًا مَّحۡمُوۡدًا
verses.en: And pray in the small watches of the morning: (it would be) an additional prayer (or spiritual profit) for thee: soon will thy Lord raise thee to a Station of Praise and Glory

verses.ar: وَقُلۡ رَّبِّ اَدۡخِلۡنِيۡ مُدۡخَلَ صِدۡقٍ وَّاَخۡرِجۡنِيۡ مُخۡرَجَ صِدۡقٍ وَّاجۡعَلۡ لِّيۡ مِنۡ لَّدُنۡكَ سُلۡطٰنًا نَّصِيۡرًا
verses.en: Say: "O my Lord! Let my entry be by the Gate of Truth and Honour, and likewise my exit by the Gate of Truth and Honour; and grant me from Thy Presence an authority to aid (me)

verses.ar: وَقُلۡ جَآءَ الۡحَقُّ وَزَهَقَ الۡبَاطِلُؕ اِنَّ الۡبَاطِلَ كَانَ زَهُوۡقًا
verses.en: And say: "Truth has (now) arrived, and Falsehood perished: for Falsehood is (by its nature) bound to perish

verses.ar: وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ الۡقُرۡاٰنِ مَا هُوَ شِفَآءٌ وَّرَحۡمَةٌ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَۙ وَلَا يَزِيۡدُ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ اِلَّا خَسَارًا
verses.en: We send down (stage by stage) in the Qur'an that which is a healing and a mercy to those who believe: to the unjust it causes nothing but loss after loss

verses.ar: وَاِذَا٘ اَنۡعَمۡنَا عَلَي الۡاِنۡسَانِ اَعۡرَضَ وَنَاٰ بِجَانِبِهٖۚ وَاِذَا مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ كَانَ يَـُٔوۡسًا
verses.en: Yet when We bestow Our favours on man, he turns away and becomes remote on his side (instead of coming to Us), and when evil seizes him he gives himself up to despair

verses.ar: قُلۡ كُلٌّ يَّعۡمَلُ عَلٰي شَاكِلَتِهٖؕ فَرَبُّكُمۡ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَنۡ هُوَ اَهۡدٰي سَبِيۡلًاࣖ‏
verses.en: Say: "Everyone acts according to his own disposition: But your Lord knows best who it is that is best guided on the Way

verses.ar: وَيَسۡـَٔلُوۡنَكَ عَنِ الرُّوۡحِؕ قُلِ الرُّوۡحُ مِنۡ اَمۡرِ رَبِّيۡ وَمَا٘ اُوۡتِيۡتُمۡ مِّنَ الۡعِلۡمِ اِلَّا قَلِيۡلًا
verses.en: They ask thee concerning the Spirit (of inspiration). Say: "The Spirit (cometh) by command of my Lord: of knowledge it is only a little that is communicated to you, (O men)

verses.ar: وَلَئِنۡ شِئۡنَا لَنَذۡهَبَنَّ بِالَّذِيۡ٘ اَوۡحَيۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡكَ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُ لَكَ بِهٖ عَلَيۡنَا وَكِيۡلًاۙ‏
verses.en: If it were Our Will, We could take away that which We have sent thee by inspiration: then wouldst thou find none to plead thy affair in that matter as against Us

verses.ar: اِلَّا رَحۡمَةً مِّنۡ رَّبِّكَؕ اِنَّ فَضۡلَهٗ كَانَ عَلَيۡكَ كَبِيۡرًا
verses.en: Except for Mercy from thy Lord: for his bounty is to thee (indeed) great

verses.ar: قُلۡ لَّئِنِ اجۡتَمَعَتِ الۡاِنۡسُ وَالۡجِنُّ عَلٰ٘ي اَنۡ يَّاۡتُوۡا بِمِثۡلِ هٰذَا الۡقُرۡاٰنِ لَا يَاۡتُوۡنَ بِمِثۡلِهٖ وَلَوۡ كَانَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ ظَهِيۡرًا
verses.en: Say: "If the whole of mankind and Jinns were to gather together to produce the like of this Qur'an, they could not produce the like thereof, even if they backed up each other with help and support

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ صَرَّفۡنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِيۡ هٰذَا الۡقُرۡاٰنِ مِنۡ كُلِّ مَثَلٍؗ فَاَبٰ٘ي اَكۡثَرُ النَّاسِ اِلَّا كُفُوۡرًا
verses.en: And We have explained to man, in this Qur'an, every kind of similitude: yet the greater part of men refuse (to receive it) except with ingratitude

verses.ar: وَقَالُوۡا لَنۡ نُّؤۡمِنَ لَكَ حَتّٰي تَفۡجُرَ لَنَا مِنَ الۡاَرۡضِ يَنۭۡ بُوۡعًاۙ‏
verses.en: They say: "We shall not believe in thee, until thou cause a spring to gush forth for us from the earth

verses.ar: اَوۡ تَكُوۡنَ لَكَ جَنَّةٌ مِّنۡ نَّخِيۡلٍ وَّعِنَبٍ فَتُفَجِّرَ الۡاَنۡهٰرَ خِلٰلَهَا تَفۡجِيۡرًاۙ‏
verses.en: Or (until) thou have a garden of date trees and vines, and cause rivers to gush forth in their midst, carrying abundant water

verses.ar: اَوۡ تُسۡقِطَ السَّمَآءَ كَمَا زَعَمۡتَ عَلَيۡنَا كِسَفًا اَوۡ تَاۡتِيَ بِاللّٰهِ وَالۡمَلٰٓئِكَةِ قَبِيۡلًاۙ‏
verses.en: Or thou cause the sky to fall in pieces, as thou sayest (will happen), against us; or thou bring Allah and the angels before (us) face to face

verses.ar: اَوۡ يَكُوۡنَ لَكَ بَيۡتٌ مِّنۡ زُخۡرُفٍ اَوۡ تَرۡقٰي فِي السَّمَآءِؕ وَلَنۡ نُّؤۡمِنَ لِرُقِيِّكَ حَتّٰي تُنَزِّلَ عَلَيۡنَا كِتٰبًا نَّقۡرَؤُهٗؕ قُلۡ سُبۡحَانَ رَبِّيۡ هَلۡ كُنۡتُ اِلَّا بَشَرًا رَّسُوۡلًاࣖ‏
verses.en: Or thou have a house adorned with gold, or thou mount a ladder right into the skies. No, we shall not even believe in thy mounting until thou send down to us a book that we could read." Say: "Glory to my Lord! Am I aught but a man,- a messenger

verses.ar: وَمَا مَنَعَ النَّاسَ اَنۡ يُّؤۡمِنُوۡ٘ا اِذۡ جَآءَهُمُ الۡهُدٰ٘ي اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ قَالُوۡ٘ا اَبَعَثَ اللّٰهُ بَشَرًا رَّسُوۡلًا
verses.en: What kept men back from belief when Guidance came to them, was nothing but this: they said, "Has Allah sent a man (like us) to be (His) Messenger

verses.ar: قُلۡ لَّوۡ كَانَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ مَلٰٓئِكَةٌ يَّمۡشُوۡنَ مُطۡمَئِنِّيۡنَ لَنَزَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ مَلَكًا رَّسُوۡلًا
verses.en: Say, "If there were settled, on earth, angels walking about in peace and quiet, We should certainly have sent them down from the heavens an angel for a messenger

verses.ar: قُلۡ كَفٰي بِاللّٰهِ شَهِيۡدًاۭ بَيۡنِيۡ وَبَيۡنَكُمۡؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهٖ خَبِيۡرًاۭ بَصِيۡرًا
verses.en: Say: "Enough is Allah for a witness between me and you: for He is well acquainted with His servants, and He sees (all things)

verses.ar: وَمَنۡ يَّهۡدِ اللّٰهُ فَهُوَ الۡمُهۡتَدِۚ وَمَنۡ يُّضۡلِلۡ فَلَنۡ تَجِدَ لَهُمۡ اَوۡلِيَآءَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖؕ وَنَحۡشُرُهُمۡ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ عَلٰي وُجُوۡهِهِمۡ عُمۡيًا وَّبُكۡمًا وَّصُمًّاؕ مَاۡوٰىهُمۡ جَهَنَّمُؕ كُلَّمَا خَبَتۡ زِدۡنٰهُمۡ سَعِيۡرًا
verses.en: It is he whom Allah guides, that is on true Guidance; but he whom He leaves astray - for such wilt thou find no protector besides Him. On the Day of Judgment We shall gather, them together, prone on their faces, blind, dumb, and deaf: their abode will be Hell: every time it shows abatement, We shall increase from them the fierceness of the Fire

verses.ar: ذٰلِكَ جَزَآؤُهُمۡ بِاَنَّهُمۡ كَفَرُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَقَالُوۡ٘ا ءَاِذَا كُنَّا عِظَامًا وَّرُفَاتًا ءَاِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوۡثُوۡنَ خَلۡقًا جَدِيۡدًا
verses.en: That is their recompense, because they rejected Our signs, and said, "When we are reduced to bones and broken dust, should we really be raised up (to be) a new Creation

verses.ar: اَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ الَّذِيۡ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ قَادِرٌ عَلٰ٘ي اَنۡ يَّخۡلُقَ مِثۡلَهُمۡ وَجَعَلَ لَهُمۡ اَجَلًا لَّا رَيۡبَ فِيۡهِؕ فَاَبَي الظّٰلِمُوۡنَ اِلَّا كُفُوۡرًا
verses.en: See they not that Allah, Who created the heavens and the earth, has power to create the like of them (anew)? Only He has decreed a term appointed, of which there is no doubt. But the unjust refuse (to receive it) except with ingratitude

verses.ar: قُلۡ لَّوۡ اَنۡتُمۡ تَمۡلِكُوۡنَ خَزَآئِنَ رَحۡمَةِ رَبِّيۡ٘ اِذًا لَّاَمۡسَكۡتُمۡ خَشۡيَةَ الۡاِنۡفَاقِؕ وَكَانَ الۡاِنۡسَانُ قَتُوۡرًاࣖ‏
verses.en: Say: "If ye had control of the Treasures of the Mercy of my Lord, behold, ye would keep them back, for fear of spending them: for man is (every) niggardly

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا مُوۡسٰي تِسۡعَ اٰيٰتٍۭ بَيِّنٰتٍ فَسۡـَٔلۡ بَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَ اِذۡ جَآءَهُمۡ فَقَالَ لَهٗ فِرۡعَوۡنُ اِنِّيۡ لَاَظُنُّكَ يٰمُوۡسٰي مَسۡحُوۡرًا
verses.en: To Moses We did give Nine Clear Signs: As the Children of Israel: when he came to them, Pharaoh said to him: "O Moses! I consider thee, indeed, to have been worked upon by sorcery

verses.ar: قَالَ لَقَدۡ عَلِمۡتَ مَا٘ اَنۡزَلَ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ اِلَّا رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ بَصَآئِرَۚ وَاِنِّيۡ لَاَظُنُّكَ يٰفِرۡعَوۡنُ مَثۡبُوۡرًا
verses.en: Moses said, "Thou knowest well that these things have been sent down by none but the Lord of the heavens and the earth as eye-opening evidence: and I consider thee indeed, O Pharaoh, to be one doomed to destruction

verses.ar: فَاَرَادَ اَنۡ يَّسۡتَفِزَّهُمۡ مِّنَ الۡاَرۡضِ فَاَغۡرَقۡنٰهُ وَمَنۡ مَّعَهٗ جَمِيۡعًاۙ‏
verses.en: So he resolved to remove them from the face of the earth: but We did drown him and all who were with him

verses.ar: وَّقُلۡنَا مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهٖ لِبَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَ اسۡكُنُوا الۡاَرۡضَ فَاِذَا جَآءَ وَعۡدُ الۡاٰخِرَةِ جِئۡنَا بِكُمۡ لَفِيۡفًاؕ‏
verses.en: And We said thereafter to the Children of Israel, "Dwell securely in the land (of promise)": but when the second of the warnings came to pass, We gathered you together in a mingled crowd

verses.ar: وَبِالۡحَقِّ اَنۡزَلۡنٰهُ وَبِالۡحَقِّ نَزَلَؕ وَمَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنٰكَ اِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَّنَذِيۡرًاۘ‏
verses.en: We sent down the (Qur'an) in Truth, and in Truth has it descended: and We sent thee but to give Glad Tidings and to warn (sinners)

verses.ar: وَقُرۡاٰنًا فَرَقۡنٰهُ لِتَقۡرَاَهٗ عَلَي النَّاسِ عَلٰي مُكۡثٍ وَّنَزَّلۡنٰهُ تَنۡزِيۡلًا
verses.en: (It is) a Qur'an which We have divided (into parts from time to time), in order that thou mightest recite it to men at intervals: We have revealed it by stages

verses.ar: قُلۡ اٰمِنُوۡا بِهٖ٘ اَوۡ لَا تُؤۡمِنُوۡاؕ اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اُوۡتُوا الۡعِلۡمَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهٖ٘ اِذَا يُتۡلٰي عَلَيۡهِمۡ يَخِرُّوۡنَ لِلۡاَذۡقَانِ سُجَّدًاۙ‏
verses.en: Say: "Whether ye believe in it or not, it is true that those who were given knowledge beforehand, when it is recited to them, fall down on their faces in humble prostration

verses.ar: وَّيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ سُبۡحٰنَ رَبِّنَا٘ اِنۡ كَانَ وَعۡدُ رَبِّنَا لَمَفۡعُوۡلًا
verses.en: And they say: 'Glory to our Lord! Truly has the promise of our Lord been fulfilled

verses.ar: وَيَخِرُّوۡنَ لِلۡاَذۡقَانِ يَبۡكُوۡنَ وَيَزِيۡدُهُمۡ خُشُوۡعًاࣛ‏
verses.en: They fall down on their faces in tears, and it increases their (earnest) humility

verses.ar: قُلِ ادۡعُوا اللّٰهَ اَوِ ادۡعُوا الرَّحۡمٰنَؕ اَيًّا مَّا تَدۡعُوۡا فَلَهُ الۡاَسۡمَآءُ الۡحُسۡنٰيۚ وَلَا تَجۡهَرۡ بِصَلَاتِكَ وَلَا تُخَافِتۡ بِهَا وَابۡتَغِ بَيۡنَ ذٰلِكَ سَبِيۡلًا
verses.en: Say: "Call upon Allah, or call upon Rahman: by whatever name ye call upon Him, (it is well): for to Him belong the Most Beautiful Names. Neither speak thy Prayer aloud, nor speak it in a low tone, but seek a middle course between

verses.ar: وَقُلِ الۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيۡ لَمۡ يَتَّخِذۡ وَلَدًا وَّلَمۡ يَكُنۡ لَّهٗ شَرِيۡكٌ فِي الۡمُلۡكِ وَلَمۡ يَكُنۡ لَّهٗ وَلِيٌّ مِّنَ الذُّلِّ وَكَبِّرۡهُ تَكۡبِيۡرًاࣖ‏
verses.en: Say: "Praise be to Allah, who begets no son, and has no partner in (His) dominion: Nor (needs) He any to protect Him from humiliation: yea, magnify Him for His greatness and glory
